title: Liria 01 – A Morning Among Strangers
summary: The first rays of sunlight fell across the city's rooftops as Liria entered the marketplace. Merchants unfolded their canvas awnings, baskets of fruit were set out, and the scent of freshly baked bread drifted through the narrow streets.
story:
The first rays of sunlight fell across the city's rooftops as Liria entered the marketplace. Merchants unfolded their canvas awnings, baskets of fruit were set out, and the scent of freshly baked bread drifted through the narrow streets.

Liria loved these hours. Before the market had truly awakened, she could watch countless small decisions come together to create a place full of life.

At an unassuming stall, she noticed an elderly merchant struggling to lift a heavy wooden crate onto her counter.

"Wait, let me help you!" Liria called cheerfully.

Together they set the crate down. The merchant thanked her with a little honey pastry, which Liria examined with curiosity.

"A new recipe?"

"My granddaughter invented it," the woman explained proudly. "Though I don't think anyone will be interested."

Liria took a bite. Her eyes lit up.

"Then we absolutely must find out whether you're right!"

An hour later, every pastry had been sold.

The merchant beamed. Liria waved a cheerful goodbye and disappeared among the visitors.

No one knew that the young woman who had just been carrying crates and selling pastries was one of the founders of Novaris.

And that was exactly how she liked it.
